suggested_fix: No fix required. The command union is fully zeroed with memset before use, so no uninitialized stack data reaches firmware, and payload_bytes is set from the size of the fixed payload struct. The parameters are only copied into a fixed-size firmware command and are not used as indexes or lengths in this function. As defense in depth, callers could check that otg_inst, panel_inst and pwrseq_inst are in range before building the command.
